name: Farstrider
lines: (5 items) When you deal direct damage with a Blink, Charge, Leap, Teleport, or Pull ability, decrease the Critical Resistance of your enemy by 40% and increase your Critical Resistance by an equal amount for 10 seconds. This effect can occur once every 7 seconds.

name: Fasalla's Guile
lines: (5 items) Adds 1487 Armor, While in combat, every 1 second you apply Minor Defile to enemies within 5 meters of you for 2 seconds, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by 6%.

name: Faun's Lark Cladding
lines: (1 item) If you continuously Sprint for 1 second, you gain the ability to pass through enemies. Enemies you pass through become Charmed for 4 seconds, removing their ability to attack or cast abilities as they move toward you. Charming an enemy this way restores 678 Stamina and Magicka to you, and heals you for 678 Health. Charming an enemy removes you from Stealth.

name: Fellowship's Fortitude
lines: (12 items) Gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by 10%.

name: Fiord's Legacy
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Reduces the cost and increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by 15%.

name: Flame Blossom
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage, you erupt a line of flame that moves forward after 1 second, dealing 1538 Flame Damage to any enemy in its path and applying the Burning status effect. This effect reveals you, can occur once every 10 seconds, and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Flanking Strategist
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 400 Weapon and Spell Damage to your damaging abilities when you attack an enemy from behind or their sides.

name: Fledgling's Nest
lines: (5 items) While in combat, casting an ability that leaves an effect on the ground creates an 8 meter Gryphon Nest for 10 seconds. You and group members inside the Nest gain 168 Magicka and Stamina Recovery. The first time you or a group member leaves the Nest, they gain Minor Courage for 10 seconds, increasing their Weapon and Spell Damage by 215. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.
